experimental_method: Flow saturation method: compressed gas bubbled through water in a steel cell at constant T, expanded through a heated needle valve, water collected in cold traps (or drying tubes) and weighed, dry-gas volume from a wet-test meter.
uncertainties_stated: Cell temperature controlled to +/-0.05 C; pressure by Bourdon gauge calibrated against dead-weight tester; no explicit uncertainty on Y2 in the table (B12 uncertainties in Table II are average deviations from the mean).
quality_remarks: No correction for residual water vapour loss (traps very efficient); no variation of water content with flow rate (0.5-1.0 l/min) so saturation assumed. CO2 data agree well with Wiebe except one 75 C point. Gas purities: ethane CP grade 99.0%, N2O 98%, CO2 99.8%. Replicate state points show scatter beyond printed digits in places (e.g. N2O 25 C, 36.5/36.7/36.7 atm: 0.00127, 0.00151, 0.00137).
not_extracted_tables: Table II (second cross virial coefficients, Kp): derived from Table I by the authors, not measured
row_counts: Table I printed data rows 78 (CO2 22, N2O 14 in left panel + 24 in right panel, C2H6 18) plus 4 label rows; written 78 plus 4 label rows (82 rows after header)
